title: cubeba mollissima
intro: Cubeba mollissima, commonly known as Pink Pepper, is a flowering plant in the family Zingiberaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cubeba mollissima include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs and colds, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include its essential oils, particularly beta-pinene, limonene, and beta-bisabolol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
